L00006: L00007: L00008: --- L00009: L00010: Dataset and code for ["DiscoveryBench: Towards Data-Driven Discovery with Large Language Models"](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2407.01725v1) L00011: L00012: --- L00013: L00014: ## 🔭 Overview L00015: L00016: DiscoveryBench is designed to systematically assess current model capabilities in data-driven discovery tasks and provide a useful resource for improving them. Each DiscoveryBench task consists of a goal and dataset(s). Solving the task requires both statistical analysis and semantic reasoning. A faceted evaluation allows open-ended final answers to be rigorously evaluated. L00017: L00018:

L00019: L00020: L00021: L00022:

L00023: L00024: L00025: This repo is structured as follows: L00026: L00027: - **DiscoveryBench**: Contains both real and synthetic datasets, located in the `discoverybench` folder. L00028: - **Discovery Agents**: Includes the code for discovery agents, found in the `agents` folder and can be instantiated using `discovery_agent.py`. L00029: - **Evaluation System**: Evaluation scripts are stored in the `eval` folder, accessible via `discovery_eval.py`. L00030: L00031: --- L00032: L00033: ## 🚀 Running Discovery Agents L00034: L00035: To run the discovery agents use the `discovery_agent.py` script as following: L00036: L00037: ``` L00038: Usage: discovery_agent.py [OPTIONS] QUERY L00039: L00040: Options: L00041: --agent_type [coder|react] Agent type to use for discovery, default is L00042: coder L00043: --model_name TEXT Model name, default is gpt-4o, available L00044: models are [gpt-4-turbo|llama-3-70b-chat|claud L00045: e-3-opus|gemini-pro]. Exhaustive list can be L00046: found in config/model_config.json L00047: --api_config TEXT API config file, default is L00048: config/api_config.json L00049: --log_file TEXT Log file L00050: --metadata_path TEXT Metadata file path [required] L00051: --metadata_type [real|synth] Metadata type [required] L00052: --add_domain_knowledge Add domain knowledge to query L00053: --add_workflow_tags Add Workflow Tags to query L00054: --help Show this message and exit. L00055: ``` L00056: L00057: ## ⚖️ Evaluating Discovery Agents L00058: L00059: To evaluate the outputs generated by the discovery agents, use the `discovery_eval.py` script as following: L00060: L00061: ``` L00062: Usage: discovery_eval.py [OPTIONS] QUERY L00063: L00064: Options: L00065: --gold_hypo TEXT Gold Hypothesis [required] L00066: --gold_workflow TEXT Gold Workflow L00067: --pred_hypo TEXT Predicted Hypothesis [required] L00068: --pred_workflow TEXT Predicted Workflow L00069: --metadata_path TEXT Metadata file path [required] L00070: --metadata_type [real|synth] Metadata type [required] L00071: --eval_output_path TEXT Evaluation output path L00072: --help Show this message and exit. L00073: ``` L00074: L00075: ## 🌟 Contributing to DiscoveryBench L00076: L00077: We welcome contributions to our repository of discovery agents. In case of any issues for the agents, evaluation, or any other bug, please follow [our issue templates](https://github.com/allenai/discoverybench/issues/new/choose). We would try to respond to as soon as possible. L00078: L00079: Reach out to us at: [Bodhisattwa Prasad Majumder](https://www.majumderb.com) and [Harshit Surana](https://harshitsurana.com) (Email: {bodhisattwam, harshits}@allenai.org). L00018: @click.command()
